chunks.text: Day six. The final cut. Forty players left. Eleven spots. And you voted A... play it safe.
So that's what I did. Every touch... simple. Every pass... to the closest teammate.
First half? Nobody noticed me. The kid next to me hit three rainbow flicks. The crowd went crazy.
But then he lost the ball. Again. And again.
Second half, I remembered what Dez said. Never waste a touch.
Thirty-one passes. Thirty-one completed. Zero turnovers.
Final whistle. Coach read the list. Name after name... mine wasn't called. Then he looked up. "Marcus. Thirty-one for thirty-one. Nobody does that. You're in."
Card check. Passing: twenty-seven to thirty-one. Defense: eighteen to twenty-two. Overall... twenty-five!
And coach said one more thing. In two days, we play a special match. Something big is coming.

chunks.title: NUMBER 7
chunks.text: So, what number do I wear? Option A: number seven.
Comment A or B. Day seven.
